name: Joshua Immanuel
title: Data & Behavioural Insights Analyst
hero: I turn messy human questions into clearer decisions.
hero_text: Economics-trained analyst working across customer behaviour, behavioural science, analytics and strategy, combining evidence, experimentation and causal reasoning to make business decisions more useful.

principles.title: Start with the decision
principles.text: A model is useful only when it clarifies what someone should do next.

principles.title: Treat behaviour as data
principles.text: Context, friction, incentives and social norms are part of the problem - not noise around it.

principles.title: Separate prediction from causality
principles.text: A strong predictor is not automatically a lever. I explicitly ask what can be changed and what can be inferred.

principles.title: Make evidence usable
principles.text: Dashboards, writing and recommendations should reduce cognitive load rather than add to it.
